meta_description: Portfolio of Ademir Ferreira, a Full-Stack Software Engineer building products with React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Rust, and Tauri.
start_value_prop: I build web and desktop products end to end, turning complex workflows into clear, reliable experiences across interfaces, APIs, and native processing.
bio_description_1: I'm Ademir, a full-stack software engineer. I enjoy turning specific problems into clear, reliable products that are pleasant to use. I'm especially interested in productivity tools, local-first software, and projects built for communities.
bio_description_2: I currently develop {leafdown}, an open-source Markdown desktop editor built with React, Rust, and native filesystem integration. I also built and deployed {nexus}, a full-stack application with authentication, shared contracts, PostgreSQL, automated tests, and CI/CD.
bio_description_3: Projects such as {cropandquest} and {fixmyhalo} grew from real problems faced by players and creators, while {pixelicons} surpassed one thousand installs on the Visual Studio Marketplace. This combination of engineering, product thinking, and practical usefulness is the kind of work that interests me most.
